name: Chitosan (High MW)
notes: Degree of deacetylation >85% affects properties significantly

name: Chitosan (Low MW)
notes: MW < 50 kDa; higher solubility; weaker films
solvent_compatible: Acetic acid, water at low pH

name: Chitosan-PVA Blend
notes: Blended with polyvinyl alcohol for improved flexibility

name: Sodium Alginate
notes: M/G ratio critical; Ca2+ crosslinking standard

name: Calcium Alginate
notes: Crosslinked with CaCl2; insoluble gel form
solvent_compatible: Insoluble in water; EDTA to dissolve

name: Cellulose Nanocrystal (CNC)
notes: Aspect ratio and surface charge affect reinforcement

name: Cellulose Nanofiber (CNF)
notes: Entangled network; higher flexibility than CNC

name: Bacterial Cellulose
notes: High purity; excellent wet strength; costly

name: Thermoplastic Starch (TPS)
notes: Plasticized with glycerol; moisture sensitive

name: Starch Nanocrystal
notes: Acid hydrolyzed; used as filler/reinforcement

name: Oxidized Starch
notes: Periodate or hypochlorite oxidation; improved solubility

name: High-Methoxyl Pectin
notes: Gel with sugar + acid; good film former

name: Low-Methoxyl Pectin
notes: Gel with Ca2+; better mechanical than HM pectin

name: Hyaluronic Acid (HA)
notes: Biomedical grade; MW > 1 MDa; hygroscopic

name: Crosslinked HA (HA-BDDE)
notes: BDDE crosslinked; slower degradation; dermal filler grade

name: Pullulan
notes: Excellent oxygen barrier; edible films; transparent

name: Pullulan-Chitosan Blend
notes: Combined oxygen barrier + antimicrobial properties

name: Dextran
notes: Medical grade; blood plasma substitute history

name: Dextran Methacrylate
notes: Photo-crosslinkable hydrogel; tunable degradation

name: Gellan Gum (High Acyl)
notes: Soft elastic gel; better flexibility

name: Gellan Gum (Low Acyl)
notes: Rigid brittle gel; higher modulus

name: Agar
notes: Traditional gel; thermoreversible; brittle films

name: Agarose
notes: Higher purity; used in electrophoresis; biomedical grade

name: Kappa-Carrageenan
notes: Strong rigid gel with K+; one helix

name: Iota-Carrageenan
notes: Soft elastic gel with Ca2+; double helix

name: Lambda-Carrageenan
notes: Non-gelling; thickener; high viscosity solutions

name: Guar Gum
notes: Thickener; nonionic; synergy with xanthan

name: Hydroxypropyl Guar
notes: Derivatized for improved clarity and reduced viscosity

name: Xanthan Gum
notes: Pseudoplastic; stable across pH/temp; anionic

name: Xanthan-Guar Synergistic Blend
notes: Synergistic gelation; improved mechanical vs either alone

name: Konjac Glucomannan
notes: Forms thermostable gel with alkali; synergy with carrageenan

name: Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC)
notes: Anionic; film former; thickener; pharma excipient

name: Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (HPMC)
notes: Thermogelling; pharma coating standard; clear films

name: Chitin Nanowhisker
notes: Highly crystalline; used as reinforcing filler
